pages.raw_title: Legence | Building Performance Platform | Engineering, HVAC & Sustainability Solutions | NASDAQ: LGN
pages.raw_meta: Legence is the largest pure-play building performance platform — delivering engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance for mission-critical facilities. 20+ brands, nationwide. NASDAQ: LGN.
raw_blocks: Learn how Legence partners with clients to deliver innovative solutions that enhance building performance and drive efficiency.
Building Better for mission-critical & High-Growth sectors
Legence partners with clients to deliver innovative solutions that enhance building performance, improve reliability, and drive efficiency.

We are a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. We focus on high-growth sectors with technically demanding buildings, including technology, life sciences, healthcare, and education.
Combining cutting edge engineering solutions with expert craftsmanship to deliver exceptional results.
With a team of MEP engineers and consultants, we deliver unparalleled expertise and innovation across new and existing buildings.
Net Zero / SQ FT
Through net zero building design, we deliver high‑performance solutions and more than 140 MW of distributed generation.
Our expert team includes HVAC and plumbing service technicians, fitters, electricians, and sheet metal workers.
As a sustainability consulting advisor, we maximize efficiency across square footage in more than 25,000 buildings.
With in-house engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance expertise and decades of experience, we ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Powering the infrastructure behind always-on digital operations, from new construction to ongoing facility performance.
Specialized systems for fabrication environments where precision, consistency, and operational control are critical.
Building systems expertise for facilities where production demands leave little room for disruption.
Facilities that support research, testing, and discovery require carefully controlled environments and dependable operation.
Supporting hospitals and healthcare facilities with building systems that keep critical services available when they matter most.
Helping K-12 and higher-ed campuses create environments that support students, faculty, research programs, and daily operations.
Engineering and infrastructure services for facilities that deliver essential services to communities every day.
Supporting owners and operators with building systems that keep workplaces, mixed-use properties, and commercial assets performing as intended.

Our Engineering & Consulting teams design HVAC and MEP systems, develop energy-saving strategies to make buildings more sustainable, and provide program/project management services for customers’ installation and retrofit projects.

Our Installation & Maintenance technicians and craftspeople fabricate and install HVAC systems, process piping and other MEP systems in new and existing industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings and provide ongoing preventative and corrective maintenance services for those systems.

pages.raw_title: About Legence | The Largest Pure-Play Building Performance Platform | NASDAQ: LGN
pages.raw_meta: Legence brings together 20+ specialized companies to deliver vertically integrated building performance solutions. A Blackstone portfolio company, publicly traded on NASDAQ (LGN). Over a century of combined expertise.
raw_blocks: Legence makes buildings better by providing essential services that improve energy efficiency, enhance reliability, and create healthier indoor environments.

We offer a range of solutions inclusive of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services. We specialize in designing, fabricating and installing HVAC, process piping and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems for new facilities and upgrading HVAC, lighting, and building controls in existing facilities to make them more energy efficient and sustainable.
Create a future in which energy-efficient, healthy, and resilient buildings are the norm, not the exception.
Legence delivers high-performance buildings by leveraging our teams’ integrated approach, technical expertise, and passion for our customers, communities, and colleagues.
Improve the well-being of people and the planet by unlocking the energy efficiency potential of buildings.
We complete more than 50,000 projects each year for clients across the U.S.
We deliver exceptional results by combining the deep industry knowledge and technical expertise of our engineers, consultants, and skilled craftspeople.
With a team of MEP engineers and consultants, we deliver unparalleled expertise and innovation across new and existing buildings.
We’re headquartered in San Jose, California, but Legence’s reach is nationwide with offices operating across the United States.
Our expert team includes HVAC and plumbing service technicians, fitters, electricians, and sheet metal workers.

United as Legence, we are a formidable force for large-scale positive impact. We are a team of experienced engineers, sustainability experts, construction managers, and craftspeople with broad industry knowledge and technical expertise. We envision a future where energy-efficient, healthy, and resilient buildings are the norm, not the exception.
60%+ of Nasdaq-100 Companies rely on Legence for High-Performance Buildings

Our business is growing rapidly as data centers, manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, schools, and universities make investments in both new and existing facilities to support growing demand for their products and services, reduce energy costs, and increase resiliency. Our innovative approach breaks down traditional industry barriers, establishing Legence as a trusted partner for organizations striving to meet high-performance goals and drive progress toward a healthier, more sustainable future.
We are a value-driven partner
We build partnerships that nurture big thinking and realize powerful solutions. Together, we question convention and discover success.
We solve complex problems by working together as coworkers, clients, and partners.
We are committed to providing the expertise and support our clients need to achieve their ambitions.
We build partnerships that nurture big thinking and realize powerful solutions. Together, we’ll question convention and discover success.
The Legence family of brands solves complex problems by working together as coworkers, clients, and partners.
We’re committed to protecting our world and supporting the wellness of all people. As part of Legence, you’ll join us in building a healthier future.
Local approach from coast to coast.
We are headquartered in San Jose, California and operate 100+ offices across the United States, delivering innovation and excellence nationwide.
Legence offers solutions designed to drive building performance, decrease costs, and overcome any project challenge.

pages.raw_title: Case Studies | Building Performance Results | Legence
pages.raw_meta: See how Legence companies deliver measurable results in energy efficiency, building performance, and sustainability for data centers, healthcare, commercial real estate, and more.
raw_blocks: An inside look into customized solutions for our clients.
Information on energy efficiency, building decarbonization, energy policy and the people behind the energy transition.
Colovore Achieves Sustainability Goals with over 6,000 Tons of Carbon Reduction in New Data Center

Rady Children’s Hospital enhanced energy efficiency, reduced costs, and improved indoor air quality through key facility upgrades. SC Engineers led the mechanical design for the new acute care hospital and central utility plant upgrade, contributing to California’s first LEED Certified hospital.
Design-build project for MEP systems at the BCOP campus in South San Francisco, including four lab/office buildings and one parking structure.
San Diego State University Engineering & Interdisciplinary Science Center

San Diego State University's vision for a cutting-edge science and engineering hub became reality with the construction of the LEED Gold-certified Engineering & Interdisciplinary Science Center, featuring advanced labs, collaborative spaces, and intricate infrastructure.
Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport
CMTA was selected as Construction Manager at Risk by the Louisville Regional Airport Authority to design and manage the construction of the new system.
Mohegan Sun Arena at Casey Plaza
CMTA conducted an investment-grade audit of Mohegan Sun Arena, identifying energy-saving needs and outdated equipment.
Sheldahl partnered with CMTA and Gilbert Mechanical to upgrade their cleanroom cooling system, enhancing efficiency, saving $8,000 annually in energy costs, and reducing carbon emissions by 15%.

Los Alamos National Laboratory (NNSA) commissioned Yearout Mechanical for the design and construction of their new Radiological Laboratory / Utility / Office Building (RLUOB). The new facility is vital to the Laboratory’s national security mission in support of NNSA’s nuclear weapons program.
George Washington University – Thurston Hall

Thurston Hall, George Washington University’s largest freshman residence, houses 825 students, faculty in residence, and residential life staff. Located just two blocks from the White House on the Foggy Bottom campus, the 100-year-old building had undergone various uses but never a comprehensive renovation. CMTA served as the MEP engineer for the 200,000-square-foot interior overhaul.

Seeking to revitalize its iconic campus and achieve LEED and WELL Platinum certifications, Horton Plaza partnered with A.O. Reed & Co. to implement a comprehensive mechanical and plumbing system overhaul, infusing sustainability and modern comfort into the 1,400,000 sq. ft. space.
Iron Mountain decided to commission the installation of 7.2 MW of solar on their data center in Edison, New Jersey, the largest rooftop solar installation of any U.S. data center.
Qualcomm partnered with A.O. Reed & Co. to enhance efficiency and reliability in their 1.7 MW data center expansion through expert mechanical and plumbing upgrades.

John Lewis Elementary in Washington, D.C., is the district's first net-zero school, prioritizing occupant health and wellness while creating a dynamic learning environment that integrates building data for a future-focused education.

For three decades, BERMO, a metal fabrication facility, relied on Gilbert Mechanical's expert care to extend the lifespan of their HVAC units to a staggering 40 years, nearly tripling the industry average, while maximizing efficiency and minimizing costs.
University of San Diego Student Life Pavillion
Massachusetts Hall - Harvard University
Margaret Mary Health Cancer Center
Legence offers solutions designed to drive building performance, decrease costs, and overcome any project challenge.
